The '''Xartan transparisteel factory''' was a facility on [[Xartun|Xartan]] producing [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. After learning it was affiliated with [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Mission to Xartun|infiltrated and destroyed]] it while posing as the crew of the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']].
